messages:
Evan Torres: FYI saw a 1.1% token shortfall in invoice-preview vs metering-emitted for a set of tenants during a 30m backpressure event last night. preview dropped while producer logs show 429s from ingest write endpoint.

Priya Reddy: interesting, which tenants and approximate window? can you paste a quick grep of the ingest logs?

Evan Torres: tenants: na-310, na-411, apac-22. window: 2026-03-20T23:40-00:10Z. logs snippet: 
```
2026-03-20T23:41:05Z WARN ingest write 429 request_id=req_20260320_aaa tokens=512 tenant=na-310 shards_inflight=128
2026-03-20T23:41:05Z INFO proxy retry emit request_id=req_20260320_aaa
2026-03-20T23:41:06Z INFO ingest write 200 request_id=req_20260320_aaa
2026-03-20T23:41:06Z ERROR ingest drop_unconfirmed request_id=req_20260320_bbb tokens=1024 tenant=apac-22 reason=backpressure_timer_expired
```
So some events were retried and eventually succeed, but a measurable fraction hit the drop path.

Samir Gupta: probable cause: our ingest write endpoint is under transient overload and we have bounded in-memory queues + a passthrough drop timer. When queueing+retry exceeds window we drop and emit a drop_metric but preview doesn't show those as dropped so they vanish from invoice-preview.

Jules Martin: from a UX perspective we need a clear "backpressure" column in preview and an explicit indicator showing "provisional tokens excluded until confirmed". Customers panic otherwise.

Priya Reddy: agree. engineering choices: (A) buffer at edge (best-effort queue persisted to local disk/redis) to absorb short spikes, (B) increase ingest consumer parallelism + autoscale faster, (C) mark dropped events as "backpressured_provisional" in preview and surface in UI + alerts. Tradeoffs: A adds complexity and storage, B costs more infra and might not eliminate short window drops, C is safest short-term.

Samir Gupta: I'd add another approach: hybrid: short-term implement C + observability; mid-term deploy bounded persistent spill (redis per-region) at edge for 10s - 60s TTL to survive edge restarts; long-term redesign protocol so ingest acks are required before preview counts.

Evan Torres: for observability we need: per-tenant metrics: metering.emitted, metering.confirmed, metering.dropped_backpressure, backlog_size. dashboard: Billing -> Preview -> Backpressure panel with 1m resolution lines for those metrics and a stacked bar for dropped reasons. alert: dropped_backpressure > 0 for >10m -> paging to platform oncall.

metering-bot: created ticket PLAT-6102: invoice-preview backpressure shortfall investigation. link: https://tickets.internal/PLAT-6102

Jules Martin: billing copy: "Preview omits events that were dropped due to transient ingestion backpressure. These events are marked 'Provisional (backpressured)' and will be reconciled if later confirmed. Final invoices only include confirmed commits. See reconciliation guidelines." I'll draft full copy.

billing-bot: policy note: any event marked dropped_backpressure must not appear on final invoice until ledger confirmation. If >500 tokens/day remain unconfirmed for a tenant, escalate to BillingOps for manual reconciliation.

Priya Reddy: short-term plan (next 72h): 
- emit metrics: metering.confirmed and metering.dropped_backpressure (Evan)
- add dashboard panel in staging with backlog_size and delta (Priya)
- implement preview UI change to show "Provisional (backpressured)" bucket and exclude from invoice totals (Jules/Billing)

Samir Gupta: mid-term plan (2-6w): prototype edge persistent spill to regional redis with bounded size and TTL. gate by tenant flag. measure success by reduction in dropped_backpressure metric. I'll own prototype.

Evan Torres: I'll instrument and wire the metrics to the billing preview backend. Use labels tenant, region, drop_reason.

Jules Martin: UX: add small stability tooltip: "If you see provisional tokens, they are excluded from invoice estimates until confirmed by the ledger consumer. We aim to reconcile within 24 hours."

Priya Reddy: canary plan: enable persistent spill for 0.5% traffic in US region for 48h. monitor metering.dropped_backpressure and ingest p99 latency. rollback if p99 > +20ms or dropped_backpressure not improved.

metering-bot: alert: PLAT-6102 created and assigned to Evan Torres.

Samir Gupta: one more operational note: make sure the edge spill has bounded disk/redis growth and evicts oldest when full to avoid OOM. We'll also emit spill_overflow metric if we evict.

Evan Torres: thanks all. follow-ups: Evan->metrics+backend, Priya->dashboard+alerts, Samir->edge spill prototype, Jules->UX & billing copy, Billing->review policy thresholds. reconvene after canary results. :eyes:
